description:
Cerebras Systems builds the world's largest AI chip, 56 times larger than GPUs. This architecture allows Cerebras to deliver industry-leading training and inference speeds; over 10 times faster than GPU-based hyperscale cloud inference services. 

This order of magnitude increase in speed is transforming the user experience of AI applications, unlocking real-time iteration and increasing intelligence via additional agentic computation.

Cerebras works with the leading model labs, global enterprises, and cutting-edge AI-native startups. OpenAI recently announced a multi-year partnership https://openai.com/index/cerebras-partnership/ with Cerebras, to deploy 750 megawatts of scale, transforming key workloads with ultra high-speed inference.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Cerebras builds AI systems that combine hardware and software. Developer Productivity provides the infrastructure and tools our engineers use to develop, build, test and deliver software.

We are looking for a Senior Staff AWS Platform Engineer to design, build and operate our AWS engineering and partner environments alongside our team. The role combines new platform development, modernization of existing environments and ongoing operation. Direct implementation is required at this level: you will personally write and test infrastructure code, configure systems, deploy changes, debug failures and participate in on-call.

You will help set technical direction and strengthen the team's expertise, agreeing on priorities and designs with engineers and leadership. You will work with IT, Network Engineering, Security and application owners as the team takes on broader ownership of AWS environments and services supporting Engineering.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Build AWS foundations. Work with the team to implement account provisioning, reusable baselines, governance integrations and shared services. Manage account and environment lifecycles with clear ownership, including sandbox expiry and retirement.

 - Plan and build networking. Work with IT, Network Engineering and Security to plan, build and operate connectivity across AWS accounts and data centers, including address planning, routing, DNS and segmentation.

 - Automate infrastructure and enable self-service. Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code (IaC) repositories, reusable modules and workflows with the team so engineers can provision, deploy and debug within approved controls. Automate initial setup, configuration and ongoing management with reviewed changes, policy checks, scoped permissions, secure state management and drift detection. Test provisioning and recovery in new environments.

 - Build and evolve engineering environments. Provision and maintain compute, container platforms, versioned base images, storage and artifact services for development and builds, including environments with restricted network access. As needs evolve, plan and execute upgrades and migrations with service owners, covering dependencies, data transfer and validation, cutover, rollback and retirement of replaced resources. Debug integration problems and validate real engineering workflows.

 - Implement isolation and secure access. Partner with Security to verify tenant isolation and approved data and artifact paths. Implement least-privilege human and workload access, resource and endpoint policies, managed secrets, encryption and audit logging.

 - Own reliability and operations. Agree on availability and recovery objectives with the team and service owners. Test alert delivery, backups, restores and emergency access. Participate in on-call, diagnose incidents and implement durable fixes. Plan capacity, quotas and costs against agreed priorities.

 - Drive delivery with the team. Help shape the roadmap with engineers and leadership. Lead agreed initiatives with clear milestones, designs and acceptance criteria aligned with stakeholders. Mentor engineers and document decisions and runbooks so others can maintain the platform.


WHAT YOU WILL BRING

 - Recent, substantial experience personally building and operating AWS infrastructure for multiple engineering teams, including new deployments, safe upgrades or migrations, troubleshooting and ongoing maintenance.

 - Direct implementation experience with AWS Organizations, account lifecycle management, governance controls, IAM roles and cross-account access.

 - Strong networking fundamentals and hands-on AWS experience with VPCs, addressing, routing, DNS, security groups, endpoints and traffic controls.

 - Substantial IaC experience, preferably Terraform: repository and module design, state management, deployment automation and safe changes across accounts and environments.

 - Ability to write, test and debug maintainable automation or service code in Python, Go or another suitable language, with error handling, retries and recovery from partial failures.

 - Hands-on experience operating AWS compute, container platforms and shared services, including Linux systems, image and configuration maintenance, storage permissions and performance, observability and recovery.

 - Experience leading infrastructure initiatives across teams, gaining agreement on designs and tradeoffs, contributing directly to implementation and operation, and developing other engineers.


THE WORK ALSO INCLUDES

You will help build and operate these capabilities with the team:

 - AWS landing zones, Control Tower or Account Factory for Terraform.

 - Shared Kubernetes/EKS platforms, including upgrades, workload access and recovery.

 - Image and configuration automation with Ansible or Packer; services such as FSx/ONTAP, Slurm or JFrog.

 - Infrastructure inventory, compliance checks or diagnostic tooling used by other engineers.

 - Identity and access integrations with IT and Security, including federation, privileged access and identity lifecycle management.


IMPACT

Success means reliable environments with fewer manual handoffs, repeatable and traceable infrastructure changes, and a team that can operate and recover the platform confidently.

Why Join Cerebras

People who are serious about software make their own hardware. At Cerebras, we have built a breakthrough architecture that is unlocking new opportunities for the AI industry. With dozens of model releases and rapid growth, we’ve reached an inflection point in our business. Members of our team tell us there are five main reasons they joined Cerebras:

 1. Build a breakthrough AI platform beyond the constraints of the GPU.

 2. Publish and open source their cutting-edge AI research.

 3. Work on one of the fastest AI supercomputers in the world.

 4. Enjoy job stability with startup vitality.

 5. Our simple, non-corporate work culture that respects individual beliefs.

Find out more about what it's like to work at Cerebras here https://www.cerebras.ai/join-us! 

Apply today and become part of the forefront of groundbreaking advancements in AI!

Cerebras Systems is committed to creating an equal and diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate different backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe inclusive teams build better products and companies. We try every day to build a work environment that empowers people to do their best work through continuous learning, growth and support of those around them.
